About Us

Nurturing Minds,
Building Futures

A trusted name in quality English-medium education in Limbayat, Surat.

Tavakkal English School was established on 10th June 2018 with a clear mission — to bring quality English-medium education to the children of Limbayat and surrounding communities of Surat.

Under the leadership of Principal Janab Usama, our school fosters an environment where every student is encouraged to discover their potential, build strong values, and develop the skills needed for a bright future.

From the very first day of Junior KG through to 12th Standard, we walk beside every student on their journey of growth and learning.

Academics

Transfer Certificates

Information on how to obtain a Transfer Certificate from Tavakkal English School.

📝

How to Apply

Submit a written application to the school office along with the parent/guardian signature. The application must mention the reason for transfer and the class the student is currently enrolled in.

📋

Documents Required

Original fee receipts, school ID card, and any library books or school property must be returned before the TC is issued. TC is typically issued within 3–5 working days.

Admissions

How to Join
Our School

Our admission process is simple and transparent. We welcome students from Jr. KG to 12th Standard.

01

Contact School

Call us or visit the school to enquire about seat availability for your desired class.

02

Submit Documents

Bring required documents — previous marksheet, birth certificate, Aadhar card, etc.

03

Fill Admission Form

Complete the official admission form at the school office with all required details.

04

Confirm & Join

Pay the fees, confirm your seat, and welcome your child to the Tavakkal family!
